scarborough.s1_head: Kitting the events trade of the Yorkshire Coast
s1loc: Scarborough runs one of the biggest open-air calendars in the country. Scarborough Open Air Theatre, a natural amphitheatre at Northstead Manor Gardens seating close to 6,000, is one of the UK's largest open-air venues and fills the summer with major touring acts. The Spa Complex carries the Grand Hall concerts, the Scarborough Spa Orchestra and the Scarborough Jazz Festival, while the Stephen Joseph Theatre, the world's first theatre-in-the-round, runs drama and cinema in its restored Odeon through the year.
